task_description: Build RECOVER-OR-RESTRICT: an AI-assisted Subscription Revenue Recovery + Trust/Access Decision Engine. Deterministic core (classifier, weighted+decayed risk score, behavioural pattern detection, RECOVER/INTERVENE/RESTRICT/SUSPEND decision engine, adaptive access state machine, revenue-at-risk), SQLite persistence, Razorpay adapter (simulation + real HMAC-SHA256 webhook verification, real event names only), OpenRouter LLM adapter with deterministic fallback so the app runs with no API key, Express REST API, 7 seeded demo scenarios distinguishing genuine failure (RECOVER) from behavioural avoidance (RESTRICT/SUSPEND), a React merchant dashboard, comprehensive tests, and a README. Full-stack TypeScript npm-workspaces monorepo, zero external infra (SQLite).

verification.summary: npm run build builds both server (tsc) and web (vite) with zero errors. npm test: 10 vitest files, 133/133 tests pass (after review fixes: +17 tests). Test quality confirmed behavioural: risk.test.ts asserts 30-day half-life decay (~half score at one half-life), success/tenure credits, and bands; api.e2e.test.ts drives the real engine over the 7 seeded scenarios and asserts scenario 6 SUSPEND+blacklist vs scenario 7 RECOVER-not-blacklist, real HMAC-SHA256 webhook verification (401/200/duplicate replay), and DB-verified audit writes. These fail if the covered logic is reverted. No Dockerfile in repo, so docker_build skipped.
